readerQuestion: How do I use a Home Assistant automation blueprint, change it for my home, and update it without unexpectedly changing every routine that depends on it?
selectedBecause: Blueprint adoption and maintenance are a distinct gap in Tara's library. Current search review, 2026 community questions about missing options and update management, and an active October blueprint exchange support a durable setup question. Community activity demonstrates interest, not search volume. The useful addition is a one-lamp acceptance walkthrough, an explicit distinction between editing inputs and taking control, and an update plan that accounts for all dependent automations. Historical constraints: parsed seo/search-performance-2026-09-21.json and seo/search-comparison-2026-09-21.json; the completed September 13-19 property chart has 3 clicks/212 impressions versus 2/205 on September 6-12. All current clicks are accounted for by tarahome and the homepage; the blog has zero. US impressions fell 111 to 72. September 20-21 are absent, not zero. Page rows total 375 impressions under a different aggregation, not site growth or an importer error; visible queries omit anonymized searches. Bluetooth's 19 recent page impressions and leak sensors' 14, both without clicks, do not establish search volume or support a strategy pivot. No meaningful recovery is established. The September 21 inspection review identifies IKEA, laundry and Spokane as indexed and trash/vacation as discovered but not indexed; these are dated observations, not present-day indexing checks. The September 15 July cohort review shows losses across devices, countries, changed and unchanged HTML, without proving a single cause or title rollback remedy. No GA4 or private inquiry data were used. Publication and mechanical checks will not establish indexing or traffic recovery.

demandSignals.evidence: March-August 2026 discussion shows difficulty managing blueprint updates, requests for dependency counts, and a reported update failure. Used as problem evidence, not a recommendation to install this custom integration or a measure of market size.

January 2026 question about adding a time-of-day restriction illustrates the difference between available blueprint inputs and editing the underlying behavior. Current review of an older discussion; it is not labeled as a new October question.

March 24, 2026 question about the safety of a newly published blueprint updater and difficulty configuring an alternative. Independent community surface supporting a simple built-in route and careful update review; no vote totals used.

Current listing shows October 2026 activity for mailbox, scheduler, lighting and notification blueprints. Establishes present-day use of the feature, not search volume, installation counts or proof that a particular blueprint works.

searchReview.intent: Import and configure a reusable household automation, then understand whether to change its inputs, detach it for customization, or update the shared blueprint. Direct Google navigation returned HTTP 429/unusual-traffic on October 12, so Google-specific ordering and related searches could not be inspected. Exact-query web search results were reviewed as the available fallback; no Google rank is asserted.
searchReview.resultGap: Official instructions accurately cover import, Take control and re-import. The reviewed July 8 explainer also covers the broad lifecycle, so this is not an absent-answer claim. Tara can add a concrete input worksheet, expected sensor-clear timing, a physical verification table, and the warning that disabling one dependent automation is not a sandbox for a shared update. Searches also surface old import videos and custom update managers; neither is necessary for the first built-in lighting exercise.

existingCoverage.decision: Read all article titles and parsed every existing topic brief's primary query and reader question; reviewed the closest article bodies and protected commercial ownership. The new owner covers importing, configuring, detaching and updating reusable blueprint definitions, not HACS installation, choice of scenes/scripts, mode troubleshooting or a production multi-sensor lighting rule. Link to the existing darkness and HACS guides for those next questions and to /home-assistant-smart-home-kit/ as the configured-service owner. Retain all indexed and unindexed topic owners. Separate refresh opportunities only: the scenes-versus-scripts article currently has Twitter title/description copied from the scene-snapshot article; review that metadata in a dedicated task. The September 21 recovery review also requests first-hand evidence for existing IKEA, Bluetooth, leak-sensor and doorbell owners, with no invented testing or factual protocol rollback. No old article, homepage, strategy or commercial page is edited by this draft. The library link provides reachability; additional contextual link suggestions will not be described as an indexing guarantee.
